verdict.rationale: The only evidence of self-hosting is community reports from an early launch thread. One user ran the Docker deploy command from PostHog's landing page and found it easy to get running. Another found the production Dockerfile and latest image broken because no database was created. There is no first-party self-hosting documentation in the pack, so the capability is evidenced but its current depth is unproven. Missing for 10: first-party self-hosting docs, evidence that the current core product is supported for self-hosting, recent hands-on corroboration, and a scaling or production deployment guide.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: A user tried the docker deploy command from the landing page and found it "super easy to get up and running."
